responsibility: Implements the C++ pretty-printer used for diagnostics and human-readable rendering of cp trees. It prints C++ identifiers, qualified names, templates, declarators, expressions, casts, lambdas, fold expressions, concepts, requires-expressions, and constraint forms by traversing C++-specific tree nodes and syntax conventions rather than relying only on generic tree printers.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable C++ pretty-printing logic that walks cp trees and renders syntax like qualified names, template-ids, requires-expressions, and constraints. Unlike cxx-pretty-print.h, which defines the printer class and declares entry points/macros, this file performs the actual formatting.
